$comment: Copy to backup-tokens.json, which is gitignored, and put your own values in.
This is where `pnpm backup:export` and `pnpm backup:restore` get an
environment's secret from, so that running one names the environment and
Each token is the same value as that environment's own BACKUP_TOKEN, the
secret its operator routes are behind. You invent it; a deployed one has to
be long and random, and anything will do locally. See docs/deployment.md,
subdomain is not a secret - it is in this repository's own documents - and
is here only because it is the other thing a command cannot work out for
itself. local needs none, deriving its port from the checkout's path.
